column1: # Reviewed differences between production's _prisma_migrations and this
# repository. The backup refuses a ledger that is not an exact
# checksum-matching prefix of prisma/migrations; these rows are the only
# deviations it accepts, and only byte for byte (name AND applied checksum).
# Any new drift still stops the backup. The rows are copied into the recovery
# DB contract by scripts/backup/hash-recovery-db-contract.sh, so every backup
# and restore receipt is bound to exactly this list.
# Read from production 13.140.132.245 on 2026-10-21 (owner-operated backup
# run 39667114027 stopped at SCHEMA_POLICY). History before the 2026-09-09
# public baseline is gone, so when the files changed cannot be recovered.
# The production schema was compared with prisma/schema.prisma the same night:
# none of these rows leaves an object the code does not know about, except that
# kb_embeddings.embedding is nullable on production while the migration and the
# schema say NOT NULL.
# Never add a row to get a backup through: find out what happened first.
# migration_name<TAB>applied_checksum<TAB>kind<TAB>what production shows
